tickets.title: Prepare Retirement Income Plan Checklist
tickets.text:
Complete these checks before presenting the retirement income plan:

- Confirm desired retirement timing and any phased-work assumptions.
- Verify recurring spending needs, irregular expenses, and emergency reserve target.
- Review Social Security claiming assumptions and pension options, if applicable.
- Identify taxable, tax-deferred, and Roth account balances available for withdrawals.
- Estimate sustainable withdrawal range under base, cautious, and stress scenarios.
- Check required minimum distribution timing and tax bracket considerations.
- Coordinate investment allocation with near-term cash flow needs.
- Identify healthcare, Medicare, long-term care, and insurance considerations.
- Document recommended income sources for the next planning period.
- List open items, assumptions, and follow-up decisions for the client.
